fields.acceptance: A Go test over a fixture model with two accepted milestone change sets with leaves, an accepted leafless milestone change set, an accepted backlog change set with leaves, one running run on a third accepted milestone change set, one interrupted run on a fourth and one failed run on a fifth picks only the first milestone change set under max 2, and none under max 1; with the fifth's failed run abandoned it picks the fifth again; a testscript runs rhiza daemon --once with a fake Rex and sees that one start.
fields.statement: Each poll, the daemon picks the accepted change sets that rhiza ready says can start, that serve a milestone intent, have at least one leaf, have no live run (running or interrupted, as run-one-live counts it) and whose latest run is not a failed run still in the inbox (as inbox-list keeps it: not abandoned, not retried, no newer run), in roadmap order, and starts them until its running runs (live runs whose process is running) reach --max-runs (default 2), so an interrupted run keeps its change set from being picked but takes no slot and a failed run's change set is never started again by the daemon until the owner clears that item; it never starts a backlog, draft, proposed or leafless change set.
